# subject-profile

First-party declarative Skill `subject-profile@0.1.0`. It declares typed inputs, a bounded Recipe and product-owned validators; it does not contain executable code.

This bundle is planning metadata for the single-user MVP. A successful registry or declarative benchmark check does not claim that geometry, render or visual similarity has passed.

The profile should carry a small detail inventory and per-region confidence (`observed`, `inferred`, or `unknown`) so later staged passes can revise one region without rewriting unrelated Part IDs. Confidence is review metadata, not a quality score and not permission to manufacture hidden structure.
